request.action_description: Skill cast: she crosses both needles in front of her chest, gathers, then flings both arms forward as if releasing threads, holds the pose, then returns to the stance. STRICT SIDE VIEW every frame: facing RIGHT in profile, chest never turns toward the camera; everything moves toward the RIGHT. She never turns around. Same character in every frame exactly as the reference image: petite adult woman, pale blonde long ponytail with a blue ribbon, red bikini top, red pleated mini skirt, brown belt with a purple pouch, brown gloves, brown thigh-high boots with silver knee guards, a long thin silver sewing needle held in EACH hand like a rapier. Same face, same proportions and same size as the reference; feet stay on the same ground line. Bold outline, clean pixels. No effects, no trails, no glow on the body.
